About

“Duetto” is a research project in which the relationship between artificial intelligence and human movement is investigated, it was born within the S+T+ARTS project, a European program that promotes the exchange between Science, Technology and Art, and is led by Sony CSL – Rome, in collaboration with Centro Coreografico Nazionale/Aterballetto, La Piroetta Dance School/Aleph Dance Company and the European University of Rome.

What we work on

Foundations

Why movement

The body is concrete enough to measure and open-ended enough to be genuinely creative — a demanding testbed for exploratory AI.

Model

The Large Movement Model

Joints as vocabulary, movement sequences as sentences — a model that learns the grammar of how a body moves through space and time.

Application

Duetto

A real-time generative system that follows a dancer's movement, learns from it, and proposes alternative trajectories in return.

Method

How it works

From video to tokens to real-time generation — the pipeline behind the live dialogue.

Theory

Staying open

A system that learns only from you risks becoming a mirror. Dreaming Learning is what lets it specialise without closing in.

Outlook

Beyond the stage

The architecture built for dance is not a dance architecture — it works for any body, in any domain.

Live

Live performances

Duetto's first public appearance, staged as a progressive experiment in human-machine interaction.
